svg.aria-label: Self_healing pipeline from fetch or drop to completion
svg.text: PER HOST · 10 in parallel · repeats for every machine in the list
o365_email_fetch.py prefers the full inventory attachment
commit before slow steps · safety pause on remediation failures
credential sets in order (hint first) · Paramiko → OpenSSH fallback
wrong password → next set · host unreachable → stop
no set worked / no route / timeout
Tanium · CrowdStrike · Azure Arc · Sentinel · rsyslog facts
AI advisory note · remediation/policy.py validates the plan
all agents ok / no sudo or no catalog fix
catalog playbook · copy tool script + RPM for EL version / arch
re-run collect_health.sh with the winning credential
each agent compared pre vs post
dated snapshot used by the run
Arrows to the right are terminal outcomes for that host or run; every host ends in exactly one status.
